product: NOX HELION EXPRESS INTEGRATOR Windows loader/installer V16
algo: Exact path→frozen donor branch→snapshot Git blob SHA-1. Compare only 40-hex Git blob SHA-1 with same Git object domain. Current source and historical base Git blob stored as context, never auto-applied.
classification_policy: One unique Git blob among changed-path donors→SKIP duplicates. Multiple blobs→ACCEPT only with unambiguous exact-path owner + signed candidate receipt + matching admitted preimage + compatibility; otherwise OWNER_HOLD. Historical overlap is not defect evidence. No merge, source edit, semantic equivalence guess, or tests.

handoff.T05: Evaluate only OWNER_HOLD rows against already-existing candidate owner receipts and matching preimages; no blind cherry-pick.
handoff.T06: Consume SKIP exclusion list and approved accept rows only; holds are explicit do-not-merge.
handoff.T02: Read this immutable T04 owner receipt; central Master/E06/Lessons write via CAS/readback only.

improvement.applied: One recursive read of frozen 25-snapshot Git tree + exact-path SHA-1 indexing replaced repeated per-branch scans; all identical donors excluded before owner-preimage checks.
improvement.evidence: 34 overlap entries, 115 changed-path donor instances, 17 identical groups
